item.title: Re: Tale about the fall of the SCP Foundation.
Re: Tale about the fall of the SCP Foundation.
item.content:encoded:
Heya.

To boil this down, it seems to be a researcher experiencing a k-class scenario. We have quite a few tales and canons set in situations like this, as well as SCP-5000. So how are you going to make yours unique, what is going to make me want to read this tale about an apocalypse rather than others?

This previous point ties into your hook. Just having to "survive" isn't inherently interesting, what is his goal or is he just aimless, what logical conclusion do you want the tale to have. Alternatively, is there something about him being a containment engineer that makes the story special? Add something to develop your story and the character further.

Hope this helped.

item.title: Tale about the fall of the SCP Foundation.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Tale

Elevator Pitch: The fall of the SCP Foundation is happening. Almost all of the SCPs have breached containment and are roaming the world. Site-[REDACTED] has almost been completely destroyed. The foundation is trying its best to re-contain all of the escaped SCPs

Central Narrative: One of the survivors of the site wide containment breach was a containment specialist, Victor. He is a very sensitive person who gets angry easily. He was in the middle of discussing containment of a recently discovered SCP when some scientists revealed to be disguised and were actually Chaos Insurgency members. The Chaos Insurgency broke into the site and freed almost all of the hostile SCPs. Victor escaped the site.

Now he has to survive in the most intense apocalypse known to mankind.

Hook/Attention Grabber: Its unique because Victor is dealing with many SCPs that have breached containment, they are possibly hostile, and he is wandering aimlessly. He has to survive a long and stressful time with not knowing what to do.

Additional Notes: I need help with the central narrative and the hook/attention grabber.
